page.overview:
Who is Landroval?

Landroval was one of the Great Eagles of Middle-earth and the brother of Gwaihir the Windlord.

Landroval was a descendant of Thorondor. It was said that Landroval and his brother Gwaihir helped Thorondor rescue Beren and Lúthien from Angband.

During the Third Age, Landroval was part of the rescue mission to save Thorin and Company from burning trees and it was possible that he fought in the Battle of Five Armies with the other Great Eagles.

Landroval assisted Gwaihir in his many associations with Gandalf and his companions. He was present at the Battle of the Black Gate, swooping to attack the Nazgûl on their Fellbeasts. Together with Gandalf, Gwaihir and Meneldor, he also rescued Frodo Baggins and Samwise Gamgee from Mordor after the completion of the Quest of the Ring.
